title: AI IDE Repair End-to-End Evidence Package Validation v0.1

acceptance: Use the controlled near-real campaign fixture and target repo.
Generate repair-handoff-package.json, dry-run repair-execution-report.json, validation-only repair-execution-report.json, and patch-plan.json.
Validate that AI IDE read order, maintainer review boundary, verification checklist, no-write proof, and redaction guarantees are coherent across the package.
Prove no patch is applied, no commit or pull request is created, no acceptance is marked passed, and no target repository source file is modified.
Update operations docs, testing strategy, acceptance checklist, decision log, dev log, and progress snapshot.
